info.name: Maaru Email Service
info.description: Email service endpoints for Maaru marketplace - buyer confirmations and seller notifications

body.raw:
{
  "emailType": "buyer_confirmation",
  "to": "buyer@example.com",
  "subject": "Order Confirmation - MR-12345678 | Maaru",
  "templateData": {
    "buyerName": "John Doe",
    "orderNumber": "MR-12345678",
    "productName": "duke 125",
    "productImage": "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQdiRp6frzKvB7TTR7TTA9pogTRAgOhAGn/5J//Z",
    "productCategory": "Others",
    "productCondition": "good",
    "quantity": 1,
    "price": 1230000,
    "total": 1230000,
    "currency": "LKR",
    "paymentMethod": "stripe",
    "shippingAddress": "123 Main St, Colombo 07, Sri Lanka",
    "phoneNumber": "+94771234567",
    "orderDate": "October 8, 2025",
    "estimatedDelivery": "October 15, 2025",
    "trackingLink": "{{frontendUrl}}/orders/MR-12345678",
    "supportEmail": "support@maaru.lk"
  }
}
